title: Booting up the PC (Withered Wasteland)
requirement: Complete the opening tutorial and reach the broken-down Pokémon Center
unlocks: The PC’s rating system activates and the Poké Life app unlocks

title: Bulbasaur’s request (Withered Wasteland)
requirement: Build a Straw Bed (2 leaves) for Bulbasaur, after building the Pretty Flower Bed, the Tree-shaded Tall Grass, the Boulder-shaded Tall Grass, and an Exercise Resting Spot for Timburr and Hitmonchan
unlocks: Withered Wasteland’s Environment Level rises to 2

title: Professor Tangrowth’s photo op
requirement: Reach Environment Level 5+ in an area where Professor Tangrowth is present
unlocks: Unlocks the "It Just Needs a Good Smack, and—Oops!" Highlight Reel photo challenge

title: Palette Town PC Shop, Level 5
requirement: Raise Palette Town’s Environment Level to 5
unlocks: The Antique table recipe becomes purchasable at the PC Shop

title: Sparkling Skylands PC Shop, Level 10
requirement: Raise Sparkling Skylands’ Environment Level to 10
unlocks: The Gaming fridge recipe becomes purchasable at the PC Shop

title: Pokédex registration: 120 entries
requirement: Register 120 Pokémon in the Pokopia Pokédex (a separate progression axis from any single area’s Environment Level)
